User story: As a patient, I want to cancel my appointment up to 2 hours before the slot, so that the slot is freed for someone else.
As a doctor, I want to see my appointments for the day in order, so that I can plan my clinic.
As a patient, I want an SMS and app reminder 24 hours and 2 hours before my appointment, so that I don't forget the visit.
As a patient, I want to search doctors by speciality, hospital and language, so that I find the right doctor.
As a patient, I want to reschedule my appointment to another free slot of the same doctor, so that I don't lose my booking when plans change.
As a patient, I want to confirm or cancel from the reminder message, so that I can respond in one tap.
As a patient, I want to book a free slot and get a confirmation number, so that my appointment is guaranteed.
As a patient, I want to book for a family member from my account, so that I can manage my parents' visits.
As a patient, I want to see a doctor's free slots for the next 14 days, so that I can pick a convenient time.
As a doctor, I want to block slots for leave or surgery, so that patients cannot book when I'm unavailable.
As a patient, I want to get a refund when I cancel a prepaid appointment, so that I don't lose money.
As a patient, I want to pay the consultation fee online while booking, so that I skip the billing queue.
As a receptionist, I want to move all of a doctor's patients to another doctor when the doctor is absent, so that patients are still seen.
